description: Create a new work order. Requires work_orders:write scope. REQUIRED: title. STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: site_id, building_id and at least one target (asset_id, location_id, system_ids or infrastructure_asset_ids) - the AssetLab app always sets one, and a work order with no target is hard to find and to cost, so ask the user which applies before calling. The API accepts a work order without a target. Also recommended: work_category_id (look up via list_work_categories; omit only if no reasonable match exists). Location hierarchy: always resolve top-down by calling list_sites first, then list_buildings filtered by site_id, then list_locations filtered by building_id.

asset_id.description: Asset this work order is for - resolve via list_assets. The server mirrors it into asset_ids.

asset_ids.description: Assets this work order covers - use instead of asset_id when there is more than one.

assigned_to.description: Assigned user ID (mapped to assignees array)

assignees.description: Array of assigned user IDs (alternative to assigned_to for multiple assignees)

building_id.description: Building ID - resolve second via list_buildings filtered by site_id

image_url.description: Image storage path (upload via create_upload_url with bucket "attachments", then set this to the returned path)

infrastructure_asset_ids.description: Infrastructure features this work order covers - resolve via list_infrastructure_assets. Use this when one job covers several features (a round of hydrant flushing); the whole selection is one work order with one completion and one cost, split across the features. Mutually exclusive with asset/location/system targets.

location_id.description: Location this work order is for - resolve last via list_locations filtered by building_id. The server mirrors it into location_ids, so send this OR location_ids, not a conflicting pair.

location_ids.description: Locations this work order covers - use instead of location_id when there is more than one. Sending location_id alone replaces this with that single id.

meter_reading.description: Meter/odometer reading at time of service

purchase_order_id.description: Purchase order that paid this work order's actual cost - resolve via list_purchase_orders. Counts against the order's remaining balance.

site_id.description: Site ID - resolve first via list_sites

system_ids.description: Systems this work order covers - resolve via list_systems. Systems have no singular field; this array is the only way to associate them.

name: create_work_order
title: Create work order
